key_idea: Red shortfall can only be covered by RG LEDs and blue shortfall only by GB LEDs; green takes whatever remains of both.
sketch: Compute the shortfalls nr, ng, nb as max(0, need - owned). If nr exceeds the RG stock, nb exceeds the GB stock, or ng exceeds the leftovers (rg-nr)+(gb-nb), print -1; otherwise the answer is nr+ng+nb since every missing LED needs exactly one purchase. O(1). Pitfall: surplus of one colour cannot be used for another.
